remarks: Charm, character & modern convenience come together in this fully renovated 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath home in desirable Springdale. Rebuilt from the studs in 2020 with new materials throughout, this home offers the feel of a newer home while maintaining timeless character. All-new high-efficiency mechanicals, gas-fueled central heating & hydro air cooling add comfort and efficiency.  Hardwood floors flow throughout the inviting open floor plan, connecting the kitchen, dining & living areas. The beautifully updated kitchen features crisp white cabinetry, granite countertops & stainless steel appliances. The light-filled primary bedroom offers two closets, while the second bedroom features a beautiful bay window. The third bedroom provides flexible space for a home office, guest room or additional living area. An updated mudroom connects to the large one-car garage.  Enjoy the backyard patio with firepit-perfect for summer BBQs & outdoor entertaining. A large, flat driveway provides ample parking.  Ideally located just a 7-minute walk to Springdale Station, with 58-minute express trains to Grand Central every half hour during rush hour. Shopping, restaurants & everyday amenities are also within easy walking distance, with convenient access to Midtown for city commuters. This beautifully renovated home offers style, flexibility, efficiency & an exceptional location!
